brief.headline_needs: All calm in the greenhouse | One thing needs you today | {n} things need you today
brief.finding: {condition} suspected in {zone}, seen in {n} analyses in a row.
brief.humid: Humidity is {rh}% in {zone}. Ventilate to keep grey mould away.
brief.vpd_low: The air in {zone} is close to saturated (VPD {vpd} kPa): leaves can't transpire. Ventilate or warm slightly.
brief.vpd_high: The air in {zone} is drying the plants hard (VPD {vpd} kPa). Mist or shade.
brief.hot: {zone} is at {temp} °C, too hot for strawberries. Ventilate or shade.
brief.cold: {zone} is down to {temp} °C, too cold for strawberries.
brief.risk_botrytis: Grey mould weather in {zone}: {hours} h humid or wet at mild temperatures.
brief.risk_powdery_mildew: Powdery mildew weather in {zone}: {hours} h warm and humid.
brief.dry: The substrate in {zone} is dry ({v}%). Check the irrigation.
brief.wet: The substrate in {zone} is waterlogged ({v}%). Skip the next irrigation.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.subtitle: How well each zone held the strawberry targets, and how the plants responded.
analytics.pattern_sub: Each square is one hour. Darker means more humid: look for the hours that repeat.
analytics.pattern_aria: {what} by hour of day, one row per day
analytics.no_data: No readings for this zone in this period yet.
analytics.pick_zone: Pick a zone to see its analytics.
analytics.in_range_line: On target {pct}% of the time ({lo} to {hi}{unit})
analytics.vpd_note: Worked out from temperature and humidity. Low VPD means wet leaves and fungal disease; high means stressed plants.
analytics.dew_note: Air temperature minus dew point. Under 2 °C, leaves can get wet: grey mould weather.
analytics.signal_note: How strongly the camera's model sees it, 0 to 1. Alerts need several sightings in a row.
analytics.insight_humid: Humidity went above 90% for about {hours} h, worst around {at}. That is when grey mould spreads: ventilate at that hour.
analytics.insight_vpd_low: VPD was below target {pct}% of the time: the leaves stayed damp. More airflow will help.
analytics.insight_condition: The camera first saw strong {condition} signs on {when}.
analytics.insight_ripening: {n} more ripe fruit in view than at the start of the period.

plant.withheld: The light was too poor to judge, so the result is held back.
plant.finding_meta: {conf}% sure, seen {n} times in a row
plant.caveat: Findings are what the camera suspects, not a diagnosis. Check the plants before treating.
